plan.description: A classic brick-breaker game built on the Next.js 16 Canvas2D scaffold featuring a paddle, bouncing ball, and a grid of destructible bricks. When bricks are destroyed, random surprise effects trigger — power-up drops (multi-ball, wide paddle, slow ball), particle burst animations, and special exploding bricks — all wired through the existing state machine, physics, and game-loop primitives.
plan.intent: Create a brick breaker game with surprises when bricks break
